title: Phase 2c execution, Layer 3: refactor under the green suite

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: 2c COMPLETE (commit follows the green gate on the #773 trail). Survey verdict: the layer landed close to shape — two items warranted movement under the green suite (the duplicated degraded-kind lookup, now one helper beside the composition root; the effectful per-repo segment helper, re-homed from main.rs's argument parsing to status::mod where the acquisition seams live). Declined, with reasons: the load-or-exit repetition in cmd_status stays (ExitCode's early-return shape reads clearer than a closure indirection at two sites); segment.rs's registered-field expect stays (the display fields are pinned versioned data; a miss is a drifted registry, and the loader's own schema-pair validation is the lawful catcher). PHASE-EXIT GATE RECORDED (gate: phase-exit-gate, phase: phase-2c, layer: 3, result: PASS; evidence: the commit on this trail; 116 tests, clippy zero, fmt clean, mdatron verify clean). Next: the phase-3 adversarial rounds.
